title: Bastion Shield managed configuration
description: Administrator settings for Bastion Shield, read through chrome.storage.managed. Every key is optional. A key that is present overrides the user's value and locks the matching control in the dashboard. Mirrors ManagedPolicy in src/shared/types.ts; see docs/DEPLOYMENT-INTUNE.md.

organizationName.title: Organisation name
organizationName.description: Shown as 'Managed by <name>' in the popup and dashboard. When set, the first-run welcome page is not opened.

supportUrl.title: Support URL
supportUrl.description: https:// link to the organisation's IT support page, shown next to the organisation name.

supportEmail.title: Support e-mail address
supportEmail.description: Address used by the 'Report a broken site' button when reportBrokenSite is 'email'. When supportEmail is set and reportBrokenSite is not, the button opens an e-mail to this address.

defaultMode.title: Default blocking mode
defaultMode.description: 'standard' (Brave Standard semantics: first-party requests are not blocked by first-party-protected lists) or 'aggressive' (block first-party requests too).

lists.title: Filter lists
lists.description: Map of filter list id to true (forced on) or false (forced off), for example {"annoyances": true}. List ids are listed in docs/FILTER-LISTS.md. Lists that are not mentioned keep the user's choice unless lockLists is true.

lockLists.title: Lock all filter lists
lockLists.description: If true, users cannot enable or disable any filter list, including lists not mentioned in 'lists'. lockSettings=true implies this unless lockLists is explicitly false.

disabledSites.title: Sites with protection off
disabledSites.description: Hostnames (for example intranet.example.ch) where Bastion Shield does not filter. Subdomains are included. No schemes, paths or wildcards.

aggressiveSites.title: Sites forced to aggressive mode
aggressiveSites.description: Hostnames where first-party requests are blocked as well. Subdomains are included.

customFilters.title: Administrator filters
customFilters.description: One filter per entry in uBlock Origin / Adblock Plus syntax. Network and cosmetic filters are supported; scriptlet filters (##+js) are ignored and need a Bastion Shield release.

allowUserSiteToggle.title: Allow users to switch protection off per site
allowUserSiteToggle.description: Default true. If false, the per-site on/off switch is locked.

allowUserFilters.title: Allow users to edit their own filters
allowUserFilters.description: Default true. If false, the custom filter editor is read-only. lockSettings=true also makes it read-only unless allowUserFilters is explicitly true.

lockSettings.title: Lock all dashboard settings
lockSettings.description: If true, users cannot change any dashboard setting, filter list or per-site mode/script/fingerprinting setting, nor their own filters. Set lockLists=false or allowUserFilters=true to leave those editable. The per-site protection switch is controlled by allowUserSiteToggle.

gpc.title: Global Privacy Control
gpc.description: Send the Sec-GPC: 1 header and expose navigator.globalPrivacyControl. Default true.

stripParams.title: Remove tracking parameters
stripParams.description: Strip Brave's list of tracking query parameters on cross-site navigations. Default true.

debounce.title: Skip bounce-tracking redirects
debounce.description: Navigate directly to the destination of known bounce-tracking links. Default true.

deAmp.title: Redirect AMP pages
deAmp.description: Redirect AMP pages to the publisher's canonical page. Default true.

fingerprinting.title: Fingerprinting protection
fingerprinting.description: Default protection level for all sites. Default 'standard'.

blockHyperlinkAuditing.title: Block hyperlink auditing
blockHyperlinkAuditing.description: Disable <a ping> click tracking in the browser. Default true.

webrtcPolicy.title: WebRTC IP handling
webrtcPolicy.description: Browser WebRTC IP handling policy set through chrome.privacy. A browser policy (WebRtcIPHandling, WebRtcLocalhostIpHandling) takes precedence.

blockThirdPartyCookies.title: Block third-party cookies
blockThirdPartyCookies.description: Set the browser's third-party cookie setting through chrome.privacy. A browser policy (BlockThirdPartyCookies) takes precedence.

disablePrivacySandboxAds.title: Turn off Privacy Sandbox ad APIs
disablePrivacySandboxAds.description: Turn off Topics, Protected Audience and Attribution Reporting through chrome.privacy. Default true.

showBadge.title: Show blocked count on the toolbar icon

showIncidentCta.title: Show the «Cyber-Vorfall?» button
showIncidentCta.description: Button in the popup and navigation that links to the Bastion incident contact form. false replaces it with the Bastion Shield name. Default true.

activityLog.title: Live activity log
activityLog.description: Record per-tab blocking activity in memory for the popup and dashboard. Default true.

historyEnabled.title: Blocking history
historyEnabled.description: Keep a blocking history on the device (never transmitted). Default true.

historyRetentionDays.title: History retention in days
historyRetentionDays.description: Days of history to keep. 0 keeps only today's totals. Default 30.

reportBrokenSite.title: Report a broken site
reportBrokenSite.description: 'github' opens a prefilled public GitHub issue that the user reviews and submits, 'email' opens a message to supportEmail, 'none' hides the button. Default: 'email' when supportEmail is set, otherwise 'github'.

nerdMode.title: Nerd mode
nerdMode.description: Forces nerd mode on or off: filter bisect, fingerprinting meter, clipboard guard, lookalike-domain warning and the Lab view (docs/NERD-MODE.md). Missing = the user decides. Default off.

clipboardGuard.title: Clipboard guard (ClickFix protection)
clipboardGuard.description: Forces the clipboard guard on or off. While nerd mode is on, it replaces shell commands (PowerShell, mshta, curl | sh …) that a page puts on the clipboard. Default true.

protectedDomains.title: Protected domains (lookalike warning)
protectedDomains.description: Registrable domains (for example bastion.ch) whose lookalikes (homoglyphs, typos, combo-squats) trigger a warning bar while nerd mode is on. Added to the built-in list and the user's own domains.

protectionEnabled.title: Protection enabled (emergency switch)
protectionEnabled.description: Fleet-wide emergency switch. false switches protection off on every site: requests are no longer blocked or redirected, no cosmetic filters, scriptlets or privacy scripts are injected, and the extension's chrome.privacy overrides are released. The extension stays installed and its popup shows that protection is off. Missing or true = normal protection; set true (or remove the key) to restore it.
